title: Return to the Rebellion
description: After narrowly escaping the Death Star with their lives, Princess Leia, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo headed directly for the Rebel base on Yavin 4. Many were relieved to see that Leia had been spared Alderaan's fate, and was returning to the Rebellion in its most desperate hour. Instahtly, the stolen technical readouts were transferred from R2-D2 and analyzed, providing Rebel leaders with a method of destroying the enormous battle station.
